base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a."XCL_003" = 'c' THEN a."XCL_001" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT a."XCL_001") 
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m."XCL_010" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN bond b ON m."XCL_010" = b."XCL_005"
WHERE m."XCL_011" = '+'
  AND b."XCL_006" = '=';

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS percentage_carbon
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM bond b
      JOIN connected c ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
      WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
        AND b.XCL_006 = '='
  )
